key_insight: In second-order statistical state dynamics, wide channel Couette turbulence is organized by a fixed-point roll-streak structure that emerges from modal instability and equilibrates as an exact attracting state at spanwise wavenumber 3.
engineering_relevance: This provides a structural reduced-order basis for predicting and controlling wall-bounded shear turbulence through a repeatable roll-streak unit cell rather than relying only on velocity-variable Navier–Stokes equilibria.
method: Formulate Couette turbulence in second-order statistical state dynamics instead of only velocity dynamics.
Identify a fixed-point state supported by a rank-1 mean flow and a conjugate pair of neutral eigenmodes.
Show the fluctuation covariance is rank-2 and regularized by roll advection, not viscosity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an exact attracting fixed point in the SSD formulation, with the wide channel turbulent state explained as a spanwise tiling of the same roll-streak unit cell.
watch_item: The result is specific to the SSD framework and wide-channel Couette setting, so translating it to other flows or finite-resolved implementations may require careful stability and closure checks.
paper_title: Statistical State Dynamics Eigenmodes and Equilibria Form the Structural Basis of Couette Turbulence
